## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (regression test for a bug fix)
- [ ] Accessibility: landmarks, labels, keyboard path, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in both themes
- [ ] Visual changes checked at 360px and desktop, light and dark; direction stated (fonts, palette, signature detail)
- [ ] README / hub card / Recall cards updated if the story changed
